source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 16 (PDF 61-84), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Electrostatics / Static Electricity) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is electrostatics? Name two phenomena it includes.
(Electrostatics kya hai? Is mein shamil do mazahir ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Electrostatics (sakin barqiyat) un mazahir ka naam hai jo sakin (stationary) charges se paida hote hain. Is mein charges ki aapas mein force, aur un ki banai hui electric field aur electric potential shamil hain (aur aalaat mein store electrical energy).

book_ref.quote: Electrostatics or static electricity refers to the phenomena arising from the stationary electric charges

blocks.prompt:
2 Define electric potential difference and write its SI unit.
(Electric potential difference ki definition aur SI unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Electric potential difference woh kaam hai jo fi unit charge, charge ko do points ke darmiyan le jane mein hota hai: V = V_B − V_A = W_AB/q₀ = ΔU/q₀. SI unit: volt, 1 V = 1 J C⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: The electric potential difference is the work done per unit charge in moving a charge between two points

blocks.prompt:
3 Define one volt.
(Aik volt ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Do points ke darmiyan potential difference aik volt hai agar aik coulomb charge ko un ke darmiyan le jane mein aik joule kaam ho: 1 V = 1 J/1 C.

book_ref.quote: The SI unit is the volt, where

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the relation between electric field and potential difference. What does it show for a uniform field?
(Electric field aur potential difference ka taluq likhein. Uniform field ke liye yeh kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = −ΔV/Δd: field faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki sharah (rate) ka negative hai. Uniform field mein E = V/d, yani do points ka potential difference field aur faasle dono ke seedha mutanasib (directly proportional) hai.

book_ref.quote: the electric field represents the rate of change of potential with distance

blocks.prompt:
5 A 9 V battery is connected to two parallel plates 0.5 cm apart. Find the electric field between them.
(9 V battery do parallel plates se jori gayi hai jo 0.5 cm door hain. Un ke darmiyan electric field nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: In the case of a uniform electric field, this relation simplifies to:

blocks.prompt:
6 Show that the units V m⁻¹ and N C⁻¹ of electric field are equivalent.
(Sabit karein ke electric field ki units V m⁻¹ aur N C⁻¹ barabar hain.)
blocks.explanation: V m⁻¹ = (J C⁻¹) m⁻¹ = (N m C⁻¹) m⁻¹ = N C⁻¹, kyun ke 1 V = 1 J C⁻¹ aur 1 J = 1 N m.

book_ref.quote: It can be converted into other units such as kilovolts or millivolts by simple scaling

blocks.prompt:
7 With respect to what is the absolute potential at a point measured in practice?
(Amli tor par kisi point ka absolute potential kis ke mutabiq naapa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nazriyati tor par infinity ko zero potential mana jata hai. Amli tor par Earth (zameen) ko zero potential mana jata hai, is liye absolute potential Earth ke mutabiq naapa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the Earth is assumed to be at zero potential practically

blocks.prompt:
8 Define electric potential at a point. Write its formula.
(Kisi point par electric potential ki definition aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi point par electric potential woh kaam hai jo unit positive charge ko infinity se us point tak electrostatic equilibrium mein lane mein hota hai. V = W/q₀ (unit: volt).

book_ref.quote: The electric potential at any point in an electric field is equal to work done in bringing a unit positive charge from infinity

blocks.prompt:
9 Why are electric potential and potential difference scalar quantities?
(Electric potential aur potential difference scalar kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke V = W/q₀, aur work W aur charge q₀ dono scalars hain. Do scalars ki nisbat bhi scalar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Both potential and potential differences are scalar quantities because both W and q

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain why potential at a point is also a potential difference.
(Wazahat karein ke kisi point ka potential bhi aik potential difference kyun hai.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi point ka potential zero potential ke reference (infinity) se naapa jata hai. Is liye yeh us point aur infinity ke darmiyan potential difference hi hai.

book_ref.quote: It is to be noted that potential at a point is still potential difference

blocks.prompt:
11 Why can ΔV = −E Δr not be applied directly to find the potential of a point charge?
(Point charge ka potential nikalne ke liye ΔV = −E Δr seedha kyun nahi lagaya ja sakta?)
blocks.explanation: ΔV = −E Δr ke liye E sabit honi chahiye. Point charge ke gird E faasle ke murabba (square) ke ulat badalti hai. Is liye bohat qareeb do points liye jate hain jahan E taqreeban sabit ho.

book_ref.quote: However in this case E varies inversely as square of distance from the point charge

blocks.prompt:
12 In deriving the potential of a point charge, why is r² taken equal to r_A r_B?
(Point charge ka potential derive karte waqt r² ko r_A r_B ke barabar kyun liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: A aur B bohat qareeb hain aur r un ka darmiyani point (arithmetic mean) hai. Bohat qareeb points ke liye arithmetic mean ko geometric mean ke barabar le lete hain, is liye r² = r_A r_B.

book_ref.quote: we can take the arithmetic mean to be equal to geometric mean

blocks.prompt:
13 Find the electric potential at a point 0.6 m from a charge of −2.0 × 10⁻⁸ C. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)
(−2.0 × 10⁻⁸ C charge se 0.6 m door point par electric potential nikalein. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))
blocks.explanation: V = (9 × 10⁹)(−2.0 × 10⁻⁸)/0.6 = −300 V. Charge negative hai is liye potential bhi negative hai.

book_ref.quote: The electric potential will be negative if the charge q is negative

blocks.prompt:
14 How is the total potential at a point due to several charges found? Why is it simpler than finding the total field?
(Kayi charges ki wajah se kisi point par kul potential kaise nikalte hain? Yeh kul field nikalne se aasan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har charge apna potential deta hai; kul potential alag alag potentials ka algebraic jama (nishan ke saath) hai. Yeh aasan hai kyun ke potential scalar hai, field ki tarah simtein jama nahi karni parteen.

book_ref.quote: the total electric potential is the algebraic sum of the individual potentials created by all the charges

blocks.prompt:
15 Charges +6 μC and −2 μC are 40 cm apart. Find the zero-potential point between them.
(+6 μC aur −2 μC charges 40 cm door hain. Un ke darmiyan zero potential wala point nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: +6 μC se x faasle par: 6/x = 2/(40 − x) → 240 − 6x = 2x → x = 30 cm (+6 μC se), yani −2 μC se 10 cm.

book_ref.quote: so there will be two zero potential points. Both the points should be closer to the smaller negative charge

blocks.prompt:
16 Why is no work done in bringing the first charge Q from infinity to point A?
(Pehle charge Q ko infinity se point A tak lane mein koi kaam kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein A par koi electric field nahi. Q kisi electric intensity ke khilaf harkat nahi karta, koi rukawat nahi, is liye W_A = 0.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, the work done to bring Q to point A is zero.

blocks.prompt:
17 Write the expression for the electric potential energy of two point charges and state where this energy comes from.
(Do point charges ki electric potential energy ka formula likhein aur batayein yeh energy kahan se aati hai.)
blocks.explanation: E_p = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r). Yeh woh kaam hai jo dono charges ko A aur B par rakhne mein (q ko Q ki field ke khilaf lane mein) hota hai aur system mein store ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the work done in placing these two charges at points A and B is stored as electric potential energy

blocks.prompt:
18 Two point charges of 2 μC and 5 μC are 3.0 cm apart. Find their electric potential energy. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)
(2 μC aur 5 μC ke do point charges 3.0 cm door hain. Un ki electric potential energy nikalein. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))

book_ref.quote: Two point charges are separated by a distance of 4.0 cm.

blocks.prompt:
19 If the separation between two point charges is reduced to one fourth, how does their electric potential energy change?
(Agar do point charges ka darmiyani faasla chautha hissa kar diya jaye to un ki electric potential energy kaise badlegi?)
blocks.explanation: E_p = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r), yani E_p ∝ 1/r. r ko r/4 karne se E_p chaar guna ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The concept of electric potential directly leads to the expression for electric potential energy of two point charges

blocks.prompt:
20 In which direction do a free positive charge and a free negative charge move in an electric field?
(Electric field mein azad positive aur azad negative charge kis taraf harkat karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Azad positive charge zyada se kam potential ki taraf accelerate karta hai; azad negative charge kam se zyada potential ki taraf harkat karta hai.

book_ref.quote: it will always accelerate from a point of higher potential to a point of lower potential

rows: Zyada se kam potential ki taraf.
Kam se zyada potential ki taraf.
Potential energy kam, kinetic energy zyada hoti hai.
Is ki bhi potential energy kam, kinetic energy zyada hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
21 What happens to the potential energy lost by a charge moving freely through a potential difference ΔV?
(Potential difference ΔV se azadana guzarne wale charge ki khoi hui potential energy kahan jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Us ki potential energy ΔU = q₀ΔV kam hoti hai aur yeh kami kinetic energy ban jati hai: ½mv² = q₀ΔV.

book_ref.quote: This decrease in potential energy of the charge will appear as its kinetic energy.

blocks.prompt:
22 A body of mass 4 × 10⁻⁶ kg carrying 2 μC starts from rest and moves through 400 V. Find its speed.
(4 × 10⁻⁶ kg mass aur 2 μC charge wala jism sukoon se 400 V se guzarta hai. Us ki raftaar nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the body will reach the point at lower potential energy with velocity v

blocks.prompt:
23 Define electron-volt and convert it into joules.
(Electron-volt ki definition likhein aur use joule mein badlein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik electron-volt woh energy hai jo electron 1 volt potential difference se accelerate ho kar hasil karta hai. 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C × 1 V = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J.

book_ref.quote: It is the energy required by an electron which has been accelerated through a potential difference of 1 volt.

blocks.prompt:
24 An electron is accelerated from rest through 1500 V. Find its kinetic energy in eV and in joules.
(Electron sukoon se 1500 V ke zariye accelerate hota hai. Us ki kinetic energy eV aur joule mein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: In atomic physics, we use one such unit of energy known as electron-volt (eV).

blocks.prompt:
25 What is a capacitor? Name the two types discussed in this chapter.
(Capacitor kya hai? Is chapter mein bayan ki gayi do aqsaam ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Capacitor aisa aala hai jo electrical energy ko electric field ki shakal mein store karta hai. Do aqsaam: (i) isolated spherical conductors, (ii) parallel plate capacitors.

book_ref.quote: A capacitor is a device that can store electrical energy in the form of electric field.

blocks.prompt:
26 What is an isolated spherical conductor? Define its capacitance.
(Isolated spherical conductor kya hai? Is ki capacitance ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jo spherical conductor doosre conductors ya asar se door rakha ho woh isolated spherical conductor hai. Is ki capacitance surface ke fi unit potential par jama charge hai: C = Q/V.

book_ref.quote: A spherical conductor placed in space such that it is far from other conductors or influence is known as an isolated spherical conductor

blocks.prompt:
27 Define one farad for a spherical conductor.
(Spherical conductor ke liye aik farad ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik farad us isolated sphere ki capacitance hai jo khali fiza mein 1 volt potential par 1 coulomb charge store kare: 1 F = 1 C/1 V.

book_ref.quote: 1 farad is the capacitance of a sphere that stores 1 coulomb of charge when its electric potential is 1 volt

blocks.prompt:
28 On what factors does the capacitance of an isolated sphere depend? Does it depend on the charge?
(Isolated sphere ki capacitance kin cheezon par munhasir hai? Kya yeh charge par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: C = 4πε₀εᵣR. Yeh sphere ke radius R aur medium (εᵣ) par munhasir hai. Charge ya potential par munhasir nahi; bara sphere usi potential par zyada charge rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: the capacitance of a spherical conductor is independent of the charge or potential

blocks.prompt:
29 Find the capacitance of an isolated sphere of radius 18 cm in air. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)
(Hawa mein 18 cm radius wale isolated sphere ki capacitance nikalein. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))

book_ref.quote: The electric potential V at the surface of the sphere of radius R is given by

blocks.prompt:
30 How does placing an isolated sphere in a dielectric medium change its capacitance?
(Isolated sphere ko dielectric medium mein rakhne se us ki capacitance par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: εᵣ wale medium mein C = 4πε₀εᵣR, is liye capacitance εᵣ guna barh jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The presence of a dielectric medium also increases the capacitance of the device.

blocks.prompt:
31 Where does the charge reside on a charged isolated spherical conductor?
(Charged isolated spherical conductor par charge kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Conductor par charge us ki bairooni surface par hota hai, poore hajm mein nahi.

book_ref.quote: On a conductor the charge lies on the outer surface

blocks.prompt:
32 Describe a parallel plate capacitor and how its plates get charged.
(Parallel plate capacitor bayan karein aur batayein us ki plates kaise charge hoti hain.)
blocks.explanation: Is mein do parallel conducting plates qareeb qareeb hoti hain jo vacuum, hawa ya dielectric se juda hoti hain. Battery V se jorne par positive terminal wali plate par +Q aur doosri par −Q aata hai.

book_ref.quote: A parallel plate, capacitor consists of two conductors placed near one another separated by vacuum, air or any other insulator

blocks.prompt:
33 Define one farad for a parallel plate capacitor.
(Parallel plate capacitor ke liye aik farad ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Capacitor ki capacitance aik farad hai agar aik plate ko aik coulomb charge dene se plates ke darmiyan aik volt potential difference paida ho.

book_ref.quote: produces a potential difference of one volt between them

blocks.prompt:
34 The charge on a capacitor is proportional to the potential difference across it. What is the constant of proportionality called and what does it measure?
(Capacitor par charge us ke potential difference ke mutanasib hai. Is tanasub ke constant ko kya kehte hain aur yeh kya naapta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Q ∝ V, is liye Q = CV. Constant C capacitor ki capacitance hai. Yeh capacitor ki charge store karne ki salahiyat ka paimana hai aur plates ki geometry aur darmiyani medium par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The proportionality constant C is called the capacitance of the capacitor.

blocks.prompt:
35 A capacitor stores 6 × 10⁻⁴ C when connected to a 30 V supply. Find its capacitance.
(Capacitor 30 V supply se jorne par 6 × 10⁻⁴ C store karta hai. Us ki capacitance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the amount of charge on one plate necessary to raise the potential of that plate by one volt with respect to the other

blocks.prompt:
36 Why is the separation between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor kept small?
(Parallel plate capacitor ki plates ka faasla chhota kyun rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taake plates ke darmiyan electric field uniform rahe aur zyada tar plates ke darmiyan hi mehdood rahe; tab E = V/d aur E = σ/ε₀ lagte hain.

book_ref.quote: The distance d is small so that the electric field E between the plates is uniform

blocks.prompt:
37 Write the formula for the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with vacuum and with a dielectric between its plates. On what factors does it depend?
(Vacuum aur dielectric ke saath parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance ka formula likhein. Yeh kin cheezon par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vacuum (hawa): C_vac = Aε₀/d. Dielectric: C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d. Yeh plates ke area A, faasle d aur darmiyani medium (εᵣ) par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Let initially the medium between the plates be air or vacuum.

blocks.prompt:
38 Find the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with plates of area 0.05 m² separated by 0.5 mm of air. (Take ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻².)
(0.05 m² area ki plates aur 0.5 mm hawa ke faasle wale parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance nikalein. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻² lein.))

book_ref.quote: As electric intensity between parallel plate capacitor (Gauss's law) is:

blocks.prompt:
39 A capacitor of 15 pF in air becomes 75 pF when a slab fills the space between its plates. Find the dielectric constant of the slab.
(Hawa mein 15 pF capacitor plates ke darmiyan slab bharne par 75 pF ho jata hai. Slab ka dielectric constant nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: εᵣ = C_med/C_vac = 75/15 = 5.

book_ref.quote: The ratio of the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with an insulating substance as medium between the plates

blocks.prompt:
40 Describe briefly the voltmeter experiment showing the effect of a dielectric on a charged capacitor.
(Charged capacitor par dielectric ka asar dikhane wala voltmeter ka tajruba mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Charged capacitor voltmeter se jora jata hai jis ki deflection V batati hai. Dielectric dalne par reading girti hai, yani V kam hota hai. Q sabit rehta hai, is liye C = Q/V barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: When a dielectric material is inserted between the plates, reading drops indicating a decrease in the potential difference between the plates

blocks.prompt:
41 What is meant by polarization of a dielectric?
(Dielectric ke polarization se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dielectric mein azad electrons nahi hote. Electric field mein har atom ke electrons nucleus ke muqable field ke ulat thora khisak jate hain. Atoms ki is shakal bigarne ko polarization kehte hain; atom polarized kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: This phenomena is known as polarization of the dielectric

blocks.prompt:
42 Where do the induced charges appear on a polarized dielectric slab placed between charged plates, and what is their effect?
(Charged plates ke darmiyan polarized dielectric slab par induced charges kahan aate hain aur un ka kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh slab ki un satahon par aate hain jo plates ko chhoo rahi hain, saath wali plate ke ulat nishan ke saath. Is se asar mein plates ka charge kam hota hai, is liye E aur V kam ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The polarity of these charges is opposite to that of the charge on the adjacent plate.

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between a conductor and a dielectric as used in a capacitor.
(Capacitor mein istemal hone wale conductor aur dielectric mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Plates conductor hain; darmiyan ka medium dielectric (insulator) hai.

book_ref.quote: It has no free electrons, i.e., all the electrons are bound to their respective positively charged nuclei.

rows: Charge bairooni surface par hota hai.
Insulator; is mein azad electrons nahi.
+Q aur −Q charge rakhta hai.
Electric field mein is ke atoms polarized ho jate hain.
Misaal: copper plates.
Capacitance ko εᵣ guna barhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
44 The plate area of a parallel plate capacitor is doubled and the separation is also doubled. What happens to its capacitance?
(Parallel plate capacitor ki plates ka area dugna aur faasla bhi dugna kar diya jaye to capacitance par kya asar hoga?)
blocks.explanation: C = Aε₀/d. Naya C = (2A)ε₀/(2d) = Aε₀/d, is liye capacitance wohi rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Let initially the medium between the plates be air or vacuum.

blocks.prompt:
45 What is meant by combination of capacitors? Why is it done?
(Capacitors ke combination se kya muraad hai? Yeh kyun kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik se zyada capacitors ko circuit mein aapas mein jorna combination kehlata hai. Yeh matlooba capacitance hasil karne ke liye kiya jata hai; combination aik equivalent capacitor ki tarah kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: When more than one capacitor are connected together in a circuit, it is known as combination of capacitors.

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between parallel and series combinations of capacitors.
(Capacitors ke parallel aur series combination mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Parallel: V aik, charges jama. Series: Q aik, voltages jama.

book_ref.quote: When capacitors are connected in parallel, their combined capacitance is equal to the sum of their individual capacitances.

rows: Har capacitor par potential difference V aik jaisa.
Har capacitor par charge Q aik jaisa.
Charges jama: Q = Q₁ + Q₂ + Q₃.
Voltages jama: V = V₁ + V₂ + V₃.
C_e = C₁ + C₂ + C₃.
C_e sab se bari capacitance se bhi zyada.
C_e sab se chhoti capacitance se bhi kam.

blocks.prompt:
47 Capacitors of 3 μF and 5 μF are connected in parallel across 20 V. Find the charge on each and the total charge.
(3 μF aur 5 μF capacitors 20 V ke saath parallel mein hain. Har aik par charge aur kul charge nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The charge on each will be different depending upon its capacitance.

blocks.prompt:
48 A 40 pF capacitor is charged to 60 V and then connected in parallel to an uncharged capacitor. The common potential becomes 24 V. Find the second capacitance.
(40 pF capacitor 60 V tak charge kar ke aik uncharged capacitor se parallel jora gaya. Mushtarka potential 24 V ho gaya. Doosri capacitance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Q = 40 × 60 = 2400 pC; C₁ par baqi = 40 × 24 = 960 pC; muntaqil Q₂ = 1440 pC; C₂ = 1440/24 = 60 pF.

book_ref.quote: As total charge remains constant, so charge shifted to

blocks.prompt:
49 Why does each capacitor in a series combination carry the same charge?
(Series combination mein har capacitor par aik jaisa charge kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Battery C₁ ki pehli plate ko +Q deti hai. Yeh doosri (insulated) plate par −Q induce karta hai, aur us se juri C₂ ki pehli plate par +Q aa jata hai, waghera. Is liye har capacitor par Q hota hai.

book_ref.quote: But the positive of the first plate induces an equal negative charge

blocks.prompt:
50 Find the equivalent capacitance of 2 μF, 3 μF and 6 μF connected in series.
(Series mein jure 2 μF, 3 μF aur 6 μF ki equivalent capacitance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The reciprocal of equivalent capacitance is equal to the sum of the reciprocals of individual capacitances

blocks.prompt:
51 Capacitors of 10 μF and 15 μF are in series across 50 V. Find the charge and the voltage on each.
(10 μF aur 15 μF series mein 50 V ke saath hain. Charge aur har aik par voltage nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: In series combination charge on each capacitor will be the same Q.

blocks.prompt:
52 In a series combination, which capacitor has the largest potential difference across it? Why?
(Series combination mein sab se zyada potential difference kis capacitor par hota hai? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se kam capacitance wale par. Sab par Q aik hai aur V = Q/C, is liye chhoti C par zyada V.

book_ref.quote: It will be different across each of them depending upon its capacitance.

blocks.prompt:
53 Give an evidence that a charged capacitor stores energy.
(Is baat ka saboot dein ke charged capacitor energy store karta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Charged capacitor ki plates moti taar se jorne par charge bahta hai aur taar garam ho jati hai. Yeh hararat usi energy se aayi jo capacitor mein charge ke waqt thi.

book_ref.quote: A good evidence of the energy stored in a charged capacitor is that of its discharging.

blocks.prompt:
54 Why is the energy stored in a capacitor ½QV and not QV?
(Capacitor mein store energy ½QV kyun hai, QV kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Charge jama hote hue potential difference 0 se V tak barhta hai, is liye baad ke hisson par zyada kaam lagta hai. Kul kaam seedhe V-Q graph ke neeche tikon ka area hai: ½QV (average voltage V/2).

book_ref.quote: a larger amount of work is needed to bring up next increment of charge

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Agar poora charge Q shuru se hi V par jata to kaam QV hota. Lekin shuru mein voltage sifar hota hai aur aahista aahista V tak barhta hai. Is liye average voltage V/2 hai aur kaam Q × V/2 = ½QV banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
55 Starting from W = ½QV, obtain the energy stored in a capacitor in terms of C and V.
(W = ½QV se shuru kar ke capacitor mein store energy C aur V ki shakal mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: W = ½QV mein Q = CV rakhein: W = ½(CV)V = ½CV².

book_ref.quote: If we put the value of Q = CV in eq. (16.39), we get

blocks.prompt:
56 A 25 μF capacitor is charged to 400 V. Find the energy stored in it.
(25 μF capacitor 400 V tak charge hai. Us mein store energy nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If we put the value of Q = CV in eq. (16.39), we get

blocks.prompt:
57 If the potential difference across a capacitor is made three times, by what factor does the stored energy change?
(Capacitor par potential difference teen guna karne se store energy kitne guna badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: W = ½CV² ∝ V². V teen guna karne se energy (3)² = 9 guna.

book_ref.quote: if V is doubled, the energy increases by a factor (2)²

blocks.prompt:
58 What is energy density of an electric field? Write its formula.
(Electric field ki energy density kya hai? Formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Energy density field ke fi unit hajm (volume) mein store energy hai: energy density = energy/volume = ½ε₀εᵣE². Unit J m⁻³.

book_ref.quote: It is also possible to regard the energy as being stored in electric field between the plates

blocks.prompt:
59 Find the energy density in air where the electric field is 1 × 10⁶ N C⁻¹. (Take ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻².)
(Hawa mein jahan electric field 1 × 10⁶ N C⁻¹ hai, energy density nikalein. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻² lein.))
